Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick sync this week. CloudSpring's Cohort 7 kicks off May 2 and we have ~12 seed-stage startups that want to run short pilots (3 months) ahead of Demo Day on June 30. Based on their usage profiles they estimate ~6–12k tokens per company for exploratory experiments.

Would Redwood consider a co-funded package — we are requesting $75k in promotional credits (marketplace vouchers or direct activation) to be split across startups, plus a possible 30-day trial extension window so teams have runway for evaluation. We can provide cohort roster and an SOW; we just need activation by May 1 to get them into your onboarding flow.

Attached: Cohort7_Roster.csv (names / company emails / cohort focus).

Open to any structured activation (per-company voucher codes, single bulk grant, or marketplace credit routing). If helpful I can loop in the accelerator ops lead.

Best,
Elliot

Folks — forwarding CloudSpring's ask. High level: they want ~$75k in promotional credits for ~12 startups, activation by 5/1, and a 30-day extension.

Quick thoughts / asks:
- Budget: $75k is above our usual accelerator match. Can we do a partial co-fund + conditions (per-startup cap, usage guardrails)?
- Fulfillment: marketplace vouchers vs single grant — what is lower friction for operations and for the startups?
- Risk: need to ensure no long-tail billing surprises; propose koy monitoring/usage caps and canary gating for first 4 startups.

Please reply with a recommendation (yes/no/terms) and I will communicate back to Elliot. Attaching recommended starter SOW (Accelerator_SOW_v2.pdf) with a few billing pathways called out.

Thanks,

Kim / team — I recommend we approve with guardrails. Proposed terms:
- Approve $50k in Redwood promotional credits (marketplace vouchers) + optional $25k top-up conditional on usage baseline after week 3.
- Per-startup cap: $10k; unused funds return to Redwood.
- 60-day trial extension for each company (to ensure Demo Day readiness).
- Activation: we'll issue per-company voucher codes via marketplace onboarding; voucher codes expire 90 days after issuance.
- Monitoring: require cohort to sign usage guardrails (attached Usage_Guardrails.md) and grant read-only billing metrics access to Redwood CS for the duration of the pilot.

Operational asks: can Product Ops generate 12 voucher codes and we route them via the accelerator program manager? If legal requires an SOW we can use the attached with minor redlines.

Marissa
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Usage_Guardrails.md (Markdown, 5KB)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cohort 7 — trial-credit co-funding request

Agree with Marissa but a couple of operational notes:
- Marketplace vouchers are easiest for audit trails but slow if partners need onboarding approvals; bulk grant via our partner-ops API can be faster and still produce a ticket for audit. Ops can support both — ETA for vouchers is ~48 hours once we have roster + emails; bulk grant can be done same-day if we approve and provide account mapping.
- Legal redlines: replace unlimited support clause with standard SLAs and include a termination clause tied to misuse. I'll push the SOW redline and share the DocuSign link once approved.
- Billing route: recommend expense code MARKET-ACCEL-2027 for internal tracking.

If we approve $50k now, I'll queue the voucher generation and set up a usage alert (80% threshold) to trigger evaluation for the $25k top-up.

— Mateo
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
